custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test with 4 in bin location A and 3 in bin location B, turn its tracking off, then change bin location A's quantity to 1 while it is untracked.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. To switch: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425633-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425633-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with the switch off, and the bins show bin location A with 1 and bin location B with 3.

Step 2:

  • The switch turns on and the bins still show the quantities as they stand now: 1 and 3, not the 4 and 3 held when tracking was turned off.

Step 3:

  • Part A's Total Qty reads 4 Available (1 + 3 = 4), not 7.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part)

  • S5-R6: “Turning tracking on shows the count as it stands.”
  • Key Decisions: “Turning tracking off only hides the count. Nothing is cleared and nothing is written off, so there is nothing to confirm. Turning tracking back on shows the count as it stands. Clearing stock while the accounting kept moving it would count the same cost twice.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
